head: 90b2751032f93de989d3d87b299081e56ca0b05f
scope: The full diff of main..f12-dispatch-picks: compiled_pick, picking and alternatives_of in closure.py; refusals_of_picks, withheld, traverse, stated_pick, Compiled and compiled in cli.py, and the guide text; PICKING, CHOICE_SEPARATOR, choices, Link.picking, fits, Placing.heading, Placing.place and collisions in dispatch.py; pointing in bundle.py; dispatches and parallel_sets in candidate.py; PICK_SECTION in provenance.py; docstrings in rewrite.py and tags.py; the two new and one renamed fixture under fixtures/dispatch; docs/dispatch.md, docs/references.md, docs/glossary.md and invocation.md; and the design commit on engineering. Callers inspected: emitted_visible (heading text through pointing), rewrite.edits and published_text (the mark drops because the destination is an anchor), candidate.shown_use, dispatched_set, cycle, analysed, selfward, unused_presets, resolved, compose's two subsection passes and the dispatched_file collision map. Probed by hand: the issue's reproduction (pick.md) publishes three bundles; a click tooltip carrying the dispatch operator and ? points at the sub-section; ? beside the ordinary preset in either case and spacing; a self-dispatch carrying ? (found warning once per alternative, fixed at 90b275103). Speculative edge cases rejected: two self-dispatch links on one line naming different selections, which the warning collection keys by link; a ? dispatch in a composed contribution, which takes the set's composed placement unchanged. The README design pin stays at 005b0ff1d so as not to carry other units' in-flight design changes; it is raised as an open question on the pull request rather than as a finding.

AC2: the same fixture's entry bundle lists one dispatch line per alternative beside its choice line in declaration order (task before epic as declared), and dispatch/a-dispatch-carrying-the-pick-token-beside-a-preset-selects-it-in-each-bundle shows a fixed preset selected in each. AC3: test_the_guide_states_each_rule_an_agent_follows_a_bundle_by asserts the guide's statement of ? on a dispatch link. AC4: dispatch/a-parallel-dispatch-carrying-the-pick-token-is-refused fails with E_UNSUPPORTED_CONSTRUCT. AC5: docs/dispatch.md (Where the links point), docs/references.md (The pick token) and the design (Dispatch links, The pick token, The agent's pick, Guide) each state the rule. AC6: make check exits 0 at 90b275103.
